claims.statement: The valuation memo states that Northgate Business Park traded at a cap rate of approximately 6.10%.

citations.quote:
Northgate Business Park traded in March 2025 for $41,000,000 ($276.10 per square foot) at a
cap rate of approximately 6.10%

claims.statement: The comps spreadsheet lists Northgate Business Park's cap rate as 5.25%, which does not match the 6.10% figure cited in the valuation memo.
